Dr. Vijay Anand Reddy is a universally acclaimed oncologist with a remarkable specialization in Radiation Therapy as well as Medical Oncology.

He is a global master in cancer treatment with extensive academic and medical sophistication and experience in various continents that include America, Europe and Australia (President of AP Chapter AROI, Premier member of ESMO, ASTRO and ASCO).
